question: Estimate monthly biscuit sales (in tonnage and value) in a Tier-2 city like Indore.
idealClarificationQuestions: All biscuit categories: glucose + cream + cookies + premium? Yes — all biscuits.
Organized + unorganized + bakery biscuits? Yes — total.
City limits or greater metropolitan? Indore municipal area (~24 lakh population).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × per-capita biscuit consumption × city-specific premium.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual biscuit consumption Indore: 24 lakh × 3.3 kg = ~80 lakh kg = ~8,000 tonnes/year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Organized (Parle, Britannia, ITC, Cadbury): ~80% = ~520 tonnes / ₹6.4 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~700 tonnes / ₹8 Cr monthly biscuit market in Indore.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3 kg/year (per Q37 Generalist doc); Indore slightly above average (Tier 2 with higher disposable income): ~3.3 kg/year.
~700 tonnes / ₹8 Cr monthly biscuit market in Indore.
